WITH rating_rentals AS (
  SELECT COUNT(r.rental_id) as rental_count
  FROM rental r
  JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
  JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(rental_count) as overall_average FROM rating_rentals
),
above_avg_rentals AS (
  SELECT rental_count
  FROM rating_rentals
  WHERE rental_count > (SELECT overall_average FROM overall_avg)
)
SELECT 
  AVG(rental_count) as avg_rentals_above_avg,
  AVG(rental_count) - (SELECT overall_average FROM overall_avg) as avg_above_overall
FROM above_avg_rentals
